<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex58032026-01-26-141843" status="unreviewed">
         <milestone unit="section" n="Text 3: dbu ba lugs su grags pa'i sems bskyed brgyud pa la phyag 'tshal ba"/>
         bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo || 
         <lg><l><rs type="deity">thub chen</rs> <rs type="deity">'jam dbyangs</rs> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3720">klu bsgrub</rs> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3702">'phags pa lha</rs> ||</l> 
        <l> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3725">zla ba grags pa</rs> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:7788">rigs pa'i khu byug</rs> dang ||</l> 
        <l><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:8059">slob pa'i rdo rje <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5555"/> dgra las rnam par rgyal</rs> ||</l> 
        <l><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:8060">rdo rje gdan pa</rs> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:8075">gnyis</rs> <note type="editorial">The “two rdo rje gdan pa” are also referred to elsewhere as “the che” and the chung.”</note> dang <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:8080">pu Na ya shri</rs>|</l> 
        <l><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:6393">ba ri lots+tsha</rs> | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4205">sa snying chen kun snying</rs> dang ||</l>
        <l><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3848">bsod nams rtse mo</rs> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:6128">grags pa rgyal mtshan</rs> dang ||</l> 
        <l><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3892">sa skya paN chen</rs> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5838">'gro mgon chos kyi rje</rs> ||</l> 
        <l><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:8011">dus 'khor ba</rs> dang <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:8082">'jam dbyangs mkhon ston</rs> dang ||</l> 
        <l><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:8083">byang chub sems dpa' chen po rin chen mgon</rs> ||</l> 
        <l>smon 'jug sems bskyed rgyud la phyag 'tshal lo ||</l></lg> </seg></TEI>
